method.pae: Actual field-goal points less expected field-goal points at 2025-26 regular-season rates in each pressure, value and distance cell
method.contest_definition: Closest defender at <4 feet. Open at >=4 feet. Shared by both models.
method.rank: Per 100 classified attempts, minimum 8 attempts, tie ranks averaged
method.top10_tiebreak: Date, NBA game ID, and NBA player ID.
method.qpix_rank: Original GitHub production QPIX, ranked only within the same eligible comparison sample.
method.data_join: NBA final game IDs and date-scoped one-game shooting records matched by verified player ID. Unclassified attempts remain excluded from both models.
